cohort: The study included 140 pregnant women with HPV infection and 150 normal pregnant women with HPV negative, all receiving obstetric examination at the First Affiliated Hospital of Hainan Medical College.
finding: Pregnant women with HPV infection during pregnancy are more likely to experience vaginal microecological disorders and have an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes such as premature delivery and chorioamnionitis.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in natural delivery rate and cesarean section rate between the HPV infection group and the control group.
cross-section timing: Vaginal secretions were collected at 28-34 weeks of gestation.
